pages.text: Frames in the tandem line don't just use sticks and wax - each one climbs on the back of the frame below it, the same way the bees themselves mutate from their parents.
Reinforced starts the tandem: a Diamond Frame plus Reinforced sticks and wax.
Draconic needs both parent frames on the workbench at once - Witheria and Reinforced - just like the bee itself needs both to mutate.
Legendary needs Witheria and Draconic, plus a Nether Star. This is the most expensive frame in the mod by a wide margin - treat it as the actual end-game goal, not a routine craft.
